rabbi-dosa.name: Rabbi Dosa
rabbi-dosa.bio: A Tanna quoted in the Mishna; here he defines the Torah’s gibben as one whose eyebrows lie over his eyes.
rabbi-dosa.prompt: A thoughtful Tanna in his 60s with a long grey beard and a careful, measured expression. He wears a plain undyed wool robe and a light mantle. Judean limestone study hall with an arched window behind him.

rav-shimi-bar-chiyya.name: Rav Shimi bar Ḥiyya
rav-shimi-bar-chiyya.bio: A Babylonian Amora, grandson and student of Rav.
rav-shimi-bar-chiyya.prompt: A young Babylonian scholar in his 20s, Rav’s grandson and student, with a short dark beard and an eager, questioning look, a wax writing tablet in one hand. Mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps of Sura behind him.
